**[@fig-vae-boxplots]** | **[Latent dimensions differ across dementia stages.]{.rev}** **A,** Boxplots comparing all six VAE latent dimensions between [the stable normal and prevalent dementia groups]{.rev} at the EWAS significance threshold of *P* < 1.0 × 10^−8^ (403 CpGs), with t-test [*P* values]{.rev} (red) at the top. **B,** Parallel analysis comparing [the stable normal group with the stable mild cognitive impairment (MCI) group]{.rev}. **C,** Distribution of VAE latent values across the dementia progression continuum in the three dimensions (VAE_6, VAE_2, VAE_4) that changed near-monotonically along the [clinical progression ordering]{.rev}: normal2mci, stable_normal, stable_mci, normal2incid, mci2incid, and prev_dementia. **D,** Four UMAP dimensions with the strongest ANOVA significance showing parallel gradual changes across the same progression ordering at THR8. [*P* values]{.rev} (red) were derived from t-tests in panels **A** and **B**, and from ANOVA in panels **C** and **D**.
